name: analytics_awv_completed_ytd
label: AWV Completed YTD
description: Count of unique attributed patients with an AWV completed in the current calendar year.

name: analytics_awv_eligible
label: AWV Eligible
description: Count of unique patients eligible for an Annual Wellness Visit under analytics-based Medicare criteria.

name: analytics_awv_gap
label: AWV Gap
description: Count of AWV-eligible patients with no completed or scheduled AWV in the current year.

name: analytics_awv_scheduled
label: AWV Scheduled
description: Count of AWV-eligible patients with a scheduled but not yet completed AWV this year.

name: awv_completion_rate_analytics
label: AWV Completion %
description: AWV completed YTD as a percentage of total AWV-eligible attributed patients.

name: awv_gap_count
label: AWV Gap (flag)
description: Attributed patients flagged as AWV gap (eligible with no completed or scheduled AWV this year). Numerator-only count; pair with analytics_awv_eligible for the rate.

name: awv_scheduled_or_completed_rate
label: AWV Scheduled or Completed %
description: Patients with an AWV scheduled or completed as a percentage of AWV-eligible patients.

name: cadence_denominator
label: Cadence Denominator
description: Denominator for on-cadence rate: attributed patients whose risk-tier cadence window is currently evaluable. Used in on_cadence_rate.

name: case_awv_actionable
label: Case AWV Actionable
description: Attributed patients whose Salesforce Case status marks them as actionable for AWV scheduling outreach in the selected period.

name: case_mddo_actionable
label: Case MDDO Actionable
description: Attributed patients whose Salesforce Case status marks them as actionable for MD/DO scheduling outreach in the selected period.

name: mddo_completion_rate
label: MDDO Completion %
description: Attributed patients with a completed qualifying MD/DO visit as a percentage of MD/DO-eligible attributed patients.

name: mddo_visit_completed_count
label: MDDO Visit Completed
description: Attributed patients with a completed qualifying MD/DO visit this year.

name: mddo_visit_scheduled_count
label: MDDO Visit Scheduled
description: Attributed patients with a scheduled but not yet completed qualifying MD/DO visit this year.

name: mdm_compliant_count
label: MDM Compliant
description: Attributed patients passing MDM (master data management) compliance filters: complete identity, not flagged as test or deleted.

name: medicare_advantage_count
label: Medicare Advantage
description: Count of unique attributed patients with Medicare Advantage as their primary coverage.

name: needs_review_count
label: Needs Review
description: Attributed patients flagged for manual review (data quality, eligibility, or attribution-source anomaly).

name: on_cadence_count
label: On Cadence
description: Attributed patients currently within their risk-tier visit cadence window. Numerator for on_cadence_rate.

name: on_cadence_rate
label: On-Cadence %
description: Patients currently within their risk-tier visit cadence as a percentage of the cadence-eligible attributed population.

name: original_medicare_count
label: Original Medicare
description: Count of unique attributed patients with Original Medicare (fee-for-service) coverage.

name: sf_mddo_actionable_count
label: MD/DO Actionable
description: Original Medicare patients marked actionable for an MD/DO visit per Salesforce Case status. Denominator for sf_mddo_completion_rate.

name: sf_mddo_completed_2026_count
label: MD/DO Completed 2026
description: Count of Original Medicare patients with a qualifying MD/DO visit completed in 2026 per Salesforce status.

name: sf_mddo_completed_2027_count
label: MD/DO Completed 2027
description: Count of Original Medicare patients with a qualifying MD/DO visit completed in 2027 per Salesforce status.

name: sf_mddo_completed_count
label: MD/DO Completed 2026
description: DEPRECATED alias of sf_mddo_completed_2026_count (pinned to 2026 and will NOT roll forward). Use the year-explicit metric in new charts.

name: sf_mddo_completion_rate
label: MD/DO Completion %
description: MD/DO completed patients as a percentage of actionable MD/DO-eligible Original Medicare patients.

name: sf_mddo_eligible_count
label: MD/DO Eligible
description: Count of active Original Medicare patients eligible for a qualifying MD/DO visit this year.

name: sf_mddo_scheduled_2026_count
label: MD/DO Scheduled 2026
description: Count of Original Medicare patients with a qualifying MD/DO visit scheduled for 2026 per Salesforce status.

name: sf_mddo_scheduled_2027_count
label: MD/DO Scheduled 2027
description: Count of Original Medicare patients with a qualifying MD/DO visit scheduled for 2027 per Salesforce status.

name: sf_mddo_scheduled_count
label: MD/DO Scheduled 2026
description: DEPRECATED alias of sf_mddo_scheduled_2026_count (pinned to 2026 and will NOT roll forward). Use the year-explicit metric in new charts.

name: total_medicare_count
label: Total Medicare
description: Count of unique attributed patients with any Medicare coverage (Original Medicare or Medicare Advantage).

name: attributed_at_risk
label: Attributed - At Risk
description: Attributed patients in the At Risk engagement segment (declining engagement signals).

name: attributed_engaged
label: Attributed - Engaged
description: Attributed patients in the Engaged segment (active recent engagement signals).

name: attributed_needs_work
label: Attributed - Needs Work
description: Attributed patients in the Needs Work segment (engagement gap requiring outreach).

name: avg_effort_gap
label: Avg Effort Gap
description: Average gap between effort score and success score across the attributed population — higher values indicate unrewarded outreach investment.

name: avg_effort_score
label: Avg Effort Score
description: Average effort score across the attributed population reflecting clinical and operational investment in patient engagement.

name: avg_success_score
label: Avg Success Score
description: Average success score across the attributed population — composite of engagement, AWV, and visit-cadence outcomes.

name: awv_completed
label: AWV Completed
description: Attributed patients with an AWV completed in the current calendar year.

name: awv_eligible
label: AWV Eligible
description: Count of unique attributed patients eligible for an Annual Wellness Visit.

name: awv_scheduled
label: AWV Scheduled
description: Attributed patients with a scheduled but not yet completed AWV this year.

name: gaining_in_progress
label: Gaining - In Progress
description: Attributed patients trending toward the Engaged segment based on recent positive engagement signals.

name: lost_despite_effort
label: Lost - Despite Effort
description: Attributed patients lost from the roster despite documented outreach effort.

name: lost_no_effort
label: Lost - No Effort
description: Attributed patients lost from the roster with no documented outreach effort.

name: mddo_completed
label: MDDO Completed
description: Attributed patients with a completed qualifying MD/DO visit this year.

name: mddo_eligible
label: MDDO Eligible
description: Count of unique attributed patients eligible for a qualifying MD/DO visit.

name: mddo_scheduled
label: MDDO Scheduled
description: Attributed patients with a scheduled but not yet completed qualifying MD/DO visit this year.

name: off_roster
label: Off Roster
description: Attributed patients not currently appearing on any payor roster file.

name: on_roster
label: On Roster
description: Count of attributed patients currently confirmed on a payor roster file.

name: truly_lost_count
label: Truly Lost
description: Attributed patients removed from all payor rosters with no concurrent re-attribution. Mirrors truly_lost_patients in mart_attribution_timeline.

name: voluntary_attributed_count
label: Voluntary Attributed
description: Count of patients voluntarily aligned to Healthcare Org under a value-based care contract.

name: attribution_unique_patients
label: Unique Patients
description: Count of unique patients with an attribution record in the selected period. NOT the canonical Active Patient definition (548-day rule); this counts attribution presence only. Renamed from attribution_active_patients to remove the misleading "active" implication.

name: attribution_active_patients
label: Unique Patients
description: DEPRECATED back-compat alias of attribution_unique_patients (identical definition). Retained only so existing saved specs/dashboards do not break at runtime; migrate to attribution_unique_patients and remove after consumers are updated.

name: avg_tenure_months
label: Avg Tenure (months)
description: Average consecutive months a patient has remained attributed to Healthcare Org without a gap.

name: dual_attributed_patients
label: Dual Attributed
description: Count of patients attributed to two or more payors in the same month.

name: gained_patients
label: Gained
description: Patients newly attributed to Healthcare Org in the selected period (first appearance on a payor roster).

name: lost_patients
label: Lost
description: Patients dropped from at least one payor roster in the selected period (may still be attributed elsewhere — see truly_lost_patients).

name: retained_patients
label: Retained
description: Patients attributed in both the previous and current period on the same payor.

name: shifted_patients
label: Shifted
description: Count of patients who shifted from one attributed payor to another in the selected period.

name: total_rows
label: Total Rows
description: Row count of the attribution timeline mart for the selected period — diagnostic, not a business KPI.

name: truly_lost_patients
label: Truly Lost
description: Count of patients removed from all rosters with no concurrent re-attribution to another payor.

name: avg_cocm_minutes
label: Avg COCM Minutes
description: Average CoCM minutes logged per behavioral health patient in the current billing month.

name: avg_gad_latest
label: Avg Latest GAD
description: Average of each BH panel patient's most recent GAD-7 anxiety screening score.

name: avg_phq_latest
label: Avg Latest PHQ
description: Average of each BH panel patient's most recent PHQ-9 depression screening score.

name: gad_assessed_count
label: GAD Assessed Count
description: BH panel patients with a current GAD-7 anxiety screening score on record.

name: gad_clinically_significant
label: GAD Clinically Significant
description: BH patients with a baseline GAD-7 score of 5 or higher, indicating clinically significant anxiety.

name: gad_remission_count
label: GAD Remission Count
description: Clinically significant GAD patients (baseline >= 5) whose latest GAD-7 score is below 5 (remission).

name: gad_response_count
label: GAD Response Count
description: Clinically significant GAD patients (baseline >= 5) with at least a 50% score reduction from baseline (response).

name: panel_size
label: Panel Size
description: Total distinct patients on the active behavioral health panel with at least one completed BH visit.

name: panel_size_current
label: Active BH Panel (Current)
description: Total distinct patients currently on the active BH panel (is_active_bh_panel = true). Timeless snapshot — ignores dashboard date range so cards always show the true current panel size including patients not seen in the selected window.

name: patients_no_next_appt
label: Patients With No Next Appointment
description: BH patients without a future behavioral health appointment scheduled, indicating potential treatment drop-off.

name: patients_with_care_plan
label: Patients With Care Plan
description: Active BH panel patients with an active CM care plan (Longitudinal or Behavioral) and at least one logged care event (cmcareevent). Legacy Behavioral-only plan flag remains on has_bh_care_plan.

name: pct_gad_assessed
label: GAD Assessed %
description: Percentage of BH panel patients with a current GAD-7 anxiety screening score on record.

name: pct_phq_assessed
label: PHQ Assessed %
description: Percentage of BH panel patients with a current PHQ-9 depression screening score on record.

name: phq_assessed_count
label: PHQ Assessed Count
description: BH panel patients with a current PHQ-9 depression screening score on record.

name: phq_clinically_significant
label: PHQ Clinically Significant
description: BH patients with a baseline PHQ-9 score of 5 or higher, indicating clinically significant depression.

name: phq_remission_count
label: PHQ Remission Count
description: BH patients whose most recent PHQ-9 score is below 5, indicating clinical remission from depression.

name: phq_response_count
label: PHQ Response Count
description: Clinically significant PHQ patients (baseline >= 5) with at least a 50% score reduction from baseline (response).

name: bh_no_show_rate
label: BH No-Show Rate %
description: Behavioral health slot no-show rate. Numerator: BH slots with slot_category = 'No Show' (cancelled at or after the appointment date). Denominator: all BH slots. Multiplied by 100 for percent display. Target below 10%.

name: cancelled_slots
label: Cancelled Slots
description: BH slots where the appointment was cancelled (slot_category = Cancelled).

name: completed_slots
label: Completed Slots
description: BH slots where the appointment was completed (checked in / checked out / charge entered).

name: fill_rate
label: Fill %
description: Completed BH slots as a share of all BH slots. Measures provider schedule utilization.

name: never_filled_slots
label: Never Filled Slots
description: BH slots that were never booked (slot_category = Never Filled).

name: no_show_slots
label: No Show Slots
description: BH slots where the patient was a no-show (slot_category = No Show).

name: scheduled_slots
label: Scheduled Slots
description: BH slots that are booked and not cancelled (slot_category = Scheduled).

name: total_slots
label: Total Slots
description: All BH appointment slots in the mart regardless of outcome.

name: utilization_pct
label: Utilization %
description: Filled or ever-booked BH slots as a share of all BH slots. Broader capacity usage measure.

name: acceptance_rate
label: Acceptance %
description: Accepted HCC suggestions as a percentage of all actionable suggestions reviewed at the encounter.

name: accepted_count
label: Accepted
description: Number of HCC code suggestions accepted by the provider at the point of documentation.

name: accepted_hcc_value
label: Accepted HCC Value
description: Sum of CMS RAF coefficients across HCC code suggestions accepted by the provider in the selected period.

name: actionable_suggestions
label: Actionable Suggestions
description: HCC code suggestions in an actionable state (excludes system-excluded and held). Denominator for acceptance_rate and assessment_rate.

name: assessed_count
label: Assessed
description: HCC code suggestions reviewed and assessed by the provider (any decision: accepted, dismissed, or marked as gap).

name: assessment_rate
label: Assessment %
description: Assessed HCC suggestions as a percentage of all actionable suggestions presented to providers.

name: dismissed_count
label: Dismissed
description: HCC code suggestions explicitly dismissed by the provider during documentation.

name: distinct_hcc_codes
label: Distinct HCC Codes
description: Distinct HCC code values appearing in suggestions across the selected period.

name: gap_count
label: Gap
description: HCC codes that were suggested but not addressed by the provider (status = NOT ADDRESSED).

name: gap_rate
label: Gap %
description: Suggestions left unaddressed (NOT ADDRESSED status) as a percentage of all actionable suggestions.

name: held_count
label: Held
description: HCC code suggestions placed in a held / pending state pending further review.

name: pending_closed_count
label: Pending Closure
description: HCC code suggestions awaiting encounter closure before final disposition.

name: recapture_candidates
label: Recapture Candidates
description: HCC code suggestions eligible for recapture (previously documented chronic conditions). Denominator for recapture_rate.

name: recapture_count
label: Recapture Accepted
description: Recapture-eligible HCC suggestions accepted by the provider in this encounter.

name: recapture_rate
label: Recapture %
description: Accepted recapture suggestions as a percentage of all recapture-eligible HCC suggestions.

name: system_excluded_count
label: System Excluded
description: HCC code suggestions automatically excluded by the system (e.g. patient-level exclusion rules) — never presented to the provider.

name: total_hcc_value
label: Total HCC Value
description: Sum of CMS RAF coefficients across all HCC code suggestions (any disposition) in the selected period.

name: total_suggestions
label: Total Suggestions
description: Total VendorNav AI HCC code suggestions presented to providers across all encounters.

name: avg_coder_acceptance_rate
label: Avg Coder Acceptance Rate
description: Average fraction of HCC suggestions accepted per coder scrub measuring coder-level coding efficiency.

name: total_hcc_autogenerated
label: Total HCC Auto-generated
description: Total visits where VendorNav AI auto-generated at least one HCC code suggestion for the coder to review.

name: total_hcc_manual
label: Total HCC Manual
description: Total visits where the coder manually added at least one HCC code beyond the auto-generated suggestions.

name: total_scrubs
label: Total Scrubs
description: Total coder scrub events performed across all visit-coder combinations.

name: avg_acceptance_rate
label: Avg Acceptance Rate
description: Average fraction of HCC suggestions accepted per provider visit pre-calculated from the source view.

name: avg_suggestions_per_visit
label: Avg Suggestions / Visit
description: Average number of HCC code suggestions presented per provider visit in the selected period.

name: review_rate
label: Review %
description: Percentage of provider visits where HCC suggestions were reviewed before documentation was closed.

name: reviewed_visits
label: Reviewed Visits
description: Provider visits where HCC suggestions were reviewed before documentation was closed. Numerator for review_rate.

name: total_accepted
label: Total Accepted
description: Total HCC code suggestions accepted across all provider visits in the selected period.

name: total_hcc_value_captured
label: Total HCC Value Captured
description: Sum of CMS Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) coefficients from all accepted HCC suggestions.

name: total_not_addressed
label: Total Not Addressed
description: Total HCC code suggestions left unaddressed (NOT ADDRESSED status) across all provider visits.

name: total_visits
label: Total Visits
description: Total provider visits with at least one HCC suggestion presented.

name: activation_rate
label: Activation Rate %
description: kpi_membership_active accounts as a share of all Membership-activated accounts. Measures funnel conversion after signup.

name: active_member_count
label: Active Member (Funnel)
description: Count of accounts at journey stage 4 (Active Member) in the membership FUNNEL. NOT the canonical Active Members count — use active_members for that.

name: active_members
label: Active Members
description: Canonical Active Members: active under the BackendBaaS legacy or Membership paying authority contract and canonically an Active patient.

name: active_members_raw
label: Active Members (Systems Raw)
description: Dual-authority active members with no patient-status gate. Diff vs active_members is the patient-status reconciliation queue.

name: attrition_count
label: Attrition Count
description: Accounts that became Declined or Inactive after activating (had a Membership member-since date).

name: attrition_rate
label: Attrition Rate %
description: Members who declined or went inactive after signing an agreement as a share of all activated accounts.

name: contract_signed_count
label: Contract Signed
description: Accounts at journey stage 3 (Contract Signed) or above in the membership funnel.

name: converted_leads
label: Converted Leads
description: Distinct leads that converted into a Membership-activated membership account.

name: declined_count
label: Declined
description: Accounts with Declined enrollment status that previously had a Membership member since date.

name: eligible_count
label: Eligible
description: Accounts at journey stage 1 (Eligible) or above in the membership funnel.

name: established_members
label: Established Members
description: kpi_membership_active members enrolled before the current measurement period (Established category).

name: inactive_member_count
label: Inactive Members
description: Accounts in Inactive Member enrollment status that previously had a Membership member-since date.

name: lead_conversion_rate
label: Lead Conversion %
description: Converted Net New leads as a share of all Net New leads. Measures lead-to-member conversion.

name: leads_count
label: Leads
description: Distinct lead records in the membership funnel for the selected period.

name: net_new_members
label: Net New Members
description: Members classified as Net New (enrolled after the membership program launch date).

name: not_eligible_count
label: Not Eligible
description: Accounts evaluated for membership and determined ineligible.

name: prospect_scheduling_rate
label: Prospect Scheduling %
description: Scheduled prospects as a share of all prospects. Measures early-funnel scheduling success.

name: prospects
label: Prospects
description: Accounts in Prospect member_type (engaged but not yet contracted). Denominator for prospect_scheduling_rate.

name: scheduled_prospects
label: Scheduled Prospects
description: Prospects with a scheduled appointment (member_type = Prospect - Scheduled).

name: total_completed_appointments
label: Completed Appointments
description: Sum of completed appointment counts across membership accounts in the selected period.

name: total_future_appointments
label: Future Appointments
description: Sum of future (scheduled) appointment counts across membership accounts as of the selected period.

name: total_members
label: Total Members
description: All accounts with a Membership member since date regardless of current enrollment status.

name: unscheduled_prospects
label: Unscheduled Prospects
description: Prospects without a scheduled appointment (member_type = Prospect - Member).

name: active_members_eom
label: Active Members (EOM)
description: Members in Active Member or Active Member - Waived enrollment status at month-end.

name: annual_plan_active_members
label: Annual Plan Active Members
description: Active members on annual cadence plans (membership_plan_rate_cents in 8333 or 9900).

name: annual_renewal_eligible_members_eom
label: Annual Renewal Eligible Members
description: Active Annual-plan members with 12+ months of tenure (renewal-eligible window).

name: annual_renewed_members_eom
label: Annual Renewed Members
description: Renewed Annual-plan members in the same eligible window.

name: avg_age_eom
label: Avg Age (EOM)
description: Average age of members in the panel at month-end.

name: avg_days_since_visit_eom
label: Avg Days Since Visit (EOM)
description: Average days since the members last completed visit at month-end.

name: churned_paying_eom
label: Churned Paying Members
description: Paying or Converted members whose Salesforce Account flipped to non-Active this month.

name: converted_members_eom
label: Converted Members (EOM)
description: Members who transitioned Grandmothered to Paying (sticky once converted).

name: declined_eom
label: Declined (EOM)
description: Members who declined after program start.

name: established_members_eom
label: Established Members (EOM)
description: Members classified as Established (pre-program-launch patients converted) at month-end.

name: gm_members_eom
label: Grandmothered Members (EOM)
description: Members in payment_status_resolved = Grandmothered Member at month-end.

name: inactive_members_eom
label: Inactive Members (EOM)
description: Members in Inactive Member enrollment with a prior Membership agreement.

name: membership_active_member_population
label: Active Member Population (Visits)
description: Distinct patients flagged as active members (denominator for visit utilization rates).

name: membership_annual_plan_pct
label: Annual Plan %
description: Share of active members on annual cadence plans.

name: membership_annual_renewal_rate
label: Annual Renewal Rate %
description: Renewed Annual members as a share of renewal-eligible Annual members.

name: membership_arpu
label: ARPU ($)
description: Average revenue per active member: MRR / Active Members. Dollar units (rate_scale=1).

name: membership_arpu_paying
label: ARPU Paying ($)
description: Average revenue per Paying member: MRR Paying / Paying Members. Dollar units (rate_scale=1).

name: membership_bh_pct
label: BH Visits %
description: Share of member visits that were behavioral health: membership_bh_visits / membership_completed_visits x 100.

name: membership_bh_visits
label: BH Visits
description: Distinct completed behavioral-health appointments where the patient was a Membership-activated membership patient at appointment time.

name: membership_cancellation_30_day_count
label: 30-Day Cancellations
description: Members who became inactive in the trailing 30 days where became_inactive_date is on or after membership_member_since. Numerator only.

name: membership_cancellation_30_day_rate
label: 30-Day Cancel Rate %
description: Share of active members who cancelled in the trailing 30 days (gated on became_inactive_date >= membership_member_since).

name: membership_legacy_count_monthly
label: Legacy Members
description: Legacy members at month-end: Membership-inferred before July 2026 and BackendBaaS-authoritative from July 2026 onward.

name: membership_ltv_paying
label: LTV (Paying)
description: Lifetime value estimate for paying members = ARPU(Paying) x avg tenure months. Excludes Grandmothered.

name: membership_members_with_visit_first_90d
label: Members w/ Visit in First 90d
description: Members whose completed visit fell within the first 90 days of their membership_member_since date.

name: membership_monthly_churn_rate
label: Monthly Churn Rate %
description: Paying members who churned this month as a share of last months paying base.

name: membership_monthly_plan_pct
label: Monthly Plan %
description: Share of active members on monthly cadence plans.

name: membership_mrr_monthly
label: MRR ($)
description: Monthly recurring revenue across all Active and Active-Waived members. Active-Waived contributes $0.

name: membership_mrr_paying
label: MRR Paying ($)
description: Monthly recurring revenue restricted to Paying and Converted members.

name: membership_paying_avg_tenure_months
label: Avg Tenure - Paying (months)
description: Average tenure in months for Paying + Converted members at end of month.

name: membership_standard_count_monthly
label: Paying Members
description: Active Membership-authoritative paying members at month-end.

name: membership_telehealth_pct
label: Telehealth %
description: Share of member visits that were telehealth: membership_telehealth_visits / membership_completed_visits x 100.

name: membership_telehealth_visits
label: Telehealth Visits
description: Distinct completed telehealth appointments where the patient was a Membership-activated membership patient at appointment time.

name: membership_visit_first_90d_pct
label: Visit-in-First-90d %
description: Share of active members who completed a visit in their first 90 days of membership.

name: membership_visits_per_member
label: Visits per Member
description: Completed member visits per active member in the panel: membership_completed_visits / membership_active_member_population.

name: monthly_plan_active_members
label: Monthly Plan Active Members
description: Canonically active members with a Membership record on monthly cadence plans (membership_billing_cadence Monthly or NULL).

name: net_new_members_eom
label: Net New Members (EOM)
description: Members classified as Net New Member (post-program-launch) at month-end.

name: net_paying_growth_eom
label: Net Paying Growth
description: new_paying_members_eom minus churned_paying_eom (pre-computed delta).

name: new_gm_members_eom
label: New Grandmothered Members
description: Approximation of new Grandmothered Members this month (parity with V2 cube).

name: new_paying_members_eom
label: New Paying Members
description: Members who became Paying this specific month.

name: nps_delta
label: NPS Delta
description: nps_promoters minus nps_detractors.

name: nps_detractors
label: NPS Detractors
description: Surveys categorized as Detractor.

name: nps_promoters
label: NPS Promoters
description: Surveys categorized as Promoter.

name: nps_response_count
label: NPS Response Count
description: Distinct NPS survey responses received this month.

name: nps_score_monthly
label: NPS Score
description: NPS = (promoters minus detractors) / responses x 100.

name: paying_members_eom
label: Paying Members (EOM)
description: Members in payment_status_resolved = Paying Member at month-end.

name: total_members_eom
label: Total Members (EOM)
description: Distinct canonical BackendBaaS-or-Membership member accounts present at month-end.

name: avg_days_since_visit
label: Avg Days Since Visit
description: Average days elapsed since each patient's most recent completed visit.

name: has_nn_case_count
label: Has NN Case
description: Active patients with an open No-Next Salesforce Case (outreach in progress to schedule the next visit).

name: no_future_appointments
label: No Future Appointments
description: Active patients with no future qualifying medical visit scheduled. See kpi_total_patients__no_next.

name: no_next_rate
label: No-Next %
description: Percentage of established patients (has_completed_pid) with no future qualifying appointment scheduled.

name: cancellation_rate
label: Cancellation Rate %
description: New Patient Visit (NPV) cohort: cancelled NPVs / total NPVs x 100. Scoped to all NPV appointment categories combined; for visit-category-specific rates see iv_cancellation_rate and mbr_cancellation_rate. NOTE: name is mart-specific (NPV) despite the bare 'cancellation_rate' label — see v3-developer-guide §2.1.1.

name: cancelled_npv
label: Cancelled NPVs
description: New Patient Visits that were cancelled.

name: completed_npv
label: Completed NPVs
description: New Patient Visits that completed.

name: completion_rate
label: Completion Rate %
description: New Patient Visit (NPV) cohort: completed NPVs / total NPVs x 100. Scoped to all NPV appointment categories combined.

name: immediate_reschedule_rate
label: Immediate Reschedule Rate %

label: Active Members

label: Member Avg Age

label: Truly Cancelled
description: Distinct cancelled appointments that were not subsequently rescheduled (true cancellations).

name: initial_visits
label: Initial Visits
description: Distinct Initial Visit appointments in the selected period.

name: awv_visits
label: AWV Visits
description: Distinct Annual Wellness Visit appointments in the selected period.

name: appointments_open_slots
label: Open Slots
description: Distinct unfilled scheduling slots in the selected period.

name: appointments_filled_slots
label: Filled Slots
description: Distinct filled scheduling slots (booked appointments) in the selected period.

name: npv_truly_lost
label: NPV Truly Lost
description: Distinct cancelled New Patient Visits never recovered (no reschedule within 30 days).

name: membership_completed_visits
label: Membership Completed Visits
description: Distinct completed appointments where the patient was a Membership-activated membership patient at appointment time.

name: unique_patients_seen
label: Unique Patients Seen
description: Distinct patients with at least one completed appointment in the selected period.

name: appointments_cancellation_rate
label: Cancellation Rate %
description: All-appointments cohort: cancelled appointments / total appointments x 100. Universal definition across all appointment types — filter via dimensions for visit-type-specific cuts. Parallel definition exists on mart_scheduling_analytics (scheduling_cancellation_rate) for the scheduling-analytics slice.

name: appointments_no_show_rate
label: No-Show Rate %
description: All-appointments cohort: no-show appointments / total appointments x 100. Universal definition; filter via dimensions for visit-type-specific cuts.

name: reschedule_rate
label: Reschedule Rate %
description: All-appointments cohort: rescheduled appointments / total appointments x 100. Universal definition across all appointment types.

name: true_cancel_rate_resolved
label: True Cancel (Resolved) %
description: All-cancelled-appointments cohort: truly cancelled (never rescheduled) / all cancelled x 100. Measures cancellation-recovery effectiveness. Excludes recovered cancellations from the numerator.

name: appointments_slot_fill_rate
label: Slot Fill Rate %
description: All-appointments cohort: filled slots / total appointment slots x 100. Universal scheduling-utilization measure.

name: scheduling_total_appointments
label: Total Appointments
description: Distinct appointments in the scheduling-analytics slice (capacity-eligible subset of mart_appointments). For the canonical company-wide count use appointments_total_appointments.

name: scheduling_completed_visits
label: Completed Visits
description: Distinct completed appointments within the scheduling-analytics slice (capacity-eligible subset).

name: scheduling_cancelled_appointments
label: Cancelled Appointments
description: Distinct cancelled appointments within the scheduling-analytics slice.

name: scheduling_no_shows
label: No-Shows
description: Distinct no-show appointments within the scheduling-analytics slice.

name: scheduling_open_slots
label: Open Slots
description: Distinct open (unfilled) slots within the scheduling-analytics slice.

name: scheduling_filled_slots
label: Filled Slots
description: Distinct filled (booked) slots within the scheduling-analytics slice.

name: scheduling_slot_fill_rate
label: Slot Fill Rate %
description: Scheduling-analytics slice: filled slots / total slots x 100. Capacity-eligible subset; for the company-wide measure use appointments_slot_fill_rate.

name: scheduling_no_show_rate
label: No-Show Rate %
description: Scheduling-analytics slice: no-shows / total appointments x 100. Capacity-eligible subset; for the company-wide measure use appointments_no_show_rate.

name: scheduling_cancellation_rate
label: Cancellation Rate %
description: Scheduling-analytics slice: cancelled / total appointments x 100. Capacity-eligible subset; for the company-wide measure use appointments_cancellation_rate.

name: vtco_cancelled_appointments
label: Cancelled Appointments
description: Cancelled appointments in the cohort month, grouped by visit-type class. Filter via the visit_type_class dimension for cohort-specific dashboards (NPV vs AWV vs Established, etc.).

name: vtco_recovered_appointments
label: Recovered Appointments
description: Cancelled appointments that were subsequently rescheduled and completed within the recovery window, grouped by visit-type class.

name: vtco_drift_appointments
label: Drift Appointments
description: Cancelled appointments that were rescheduled to a future date beyond the recovery window (drifted), grouped by visit-type class.

name: vtco_hard_leakage_appointments
label: Hard Leakage Appointments
description: Cancelled appointments never recovered (patient did not return), grouped by visit-type class.

name: vtco_recovered_pct
label: Recovered %
description: Recovered appointments / cancelled appointments x 100 within the cohort month and visit-type class. Universal definition — apply visit_type_class filter for NPV / AWV / Established dashboards.

name: vtco_drift_pct
label: Drift %
description: Drift appointments / cancelled appointments x 100 within the cohort month and visit-type class. Universal definition — apply visit_type_class filter for cohort-specific dashboards.

name: vtco_hard_leakage_pct
label: Hard Leakage %
description: Hard-leakage (never-recovered) cancellations / cancelled appointments x 100 within the cohort month and visit-type class. Universal definition — apply visit_type_class filter for cohort-specific dashboards.

name: engagement_cohort_18m_patients
label: 18-month Cohort Patients
description: Patients with >=1 completed visit in the trailing 18-month (548-day) window at cohort month-end. NOT the canonical Active Patient definition; engagement-cohort scope only.

name: cohort_month_active_patient_sum
label: Active Patients
description: Active patient count in the cohort month — denominator for patient_leakage_pct and no_future_appt_pct. NOTE: name collides with active_patients in mart_attribution_timeline; this row's definition is cohort-month-scoped engagement, not attribution.

name: leaked_patients_90d
label: Leaked Patients (90d)
description: Cohort-month patients with no completed or scheduled visit within 90 days of cohort start (engagement leakage).

name: patient_leakage_pct
label: Patient Leakage %
description: Cohort cohort-month leakage rate: leaked patients (90d) / active patients x 100.

name: no_future_appt_patients
label: No Future Appointment Patients
description: Cohort-month patients with no future appointment scheduled as of cohort evaluation.

name: no_future_appt_pct
label: No Future Appointment %
description: Cohort-month: patients with no future appointment / active patients x 100.

name: scheduled_appointments
label: Scheduled Appointments
description: Scheduled appointments in the cohort month — denominator for appt_truly_cancelled_pct.

name: leakage_truly_cancelled_appointments
label: Truly Cancelled Appointments
description: Cohort-month appointments truly cancelled (cancelled without subsequent reschedule). Numerator for appt_truly_cancelled_pct.

name: appt_truly_cancelled_pct
label: Appt Truly Cancelled %
description: Cohort-month rate: truly cancelled appointments / scheduled appointments x 100. A truly cancelled appointment was not subsequently rescheduled.

name: imaging_total_capacity
label: Total Capacity (Slots)
description: Distinct imaging appointment slots (Mammogram, DEXA, Body Comp) at Healthcare Org onsite clinics. 504 Mammo & DEXA combined slots count once in the total.

name: imaging_open_slots
label: Open Slots
description: Distinct imaging slots that are open (no patient booked).

name: imaging_filled_slots
label: Filled Slots
description: Distinct imaging slots that are booked and not cancelled.

name: imaging_completed_slots
label: Completed Slots
description: Distinct imaging slots where the appointment was completed (status Checked In / Checked Out / Charge Entered).

name: imaging_cancelled_slots
label: Cancelled Slots
description: Distinct imaging slots whose appointment was cancelled.

name: imaging_utilization_pct
label: Utilization %
description: Filled imaging slots as a percentage of total imaging slots. Numerator: filled_slot_aid. Denominator: slot_aid.

name: imaging_completion_pct
label: Completion %
description: Completed imaging slots as a percentage of total imaging slots. Numerator: completed_slot_aid. Denominator: slot_aid.

name: imaging_total_orders
label: Total Imaging Orders
description: Distinct imaging order documents (CLINICALORDERTYPE matching Mammo / DEXA / Bone Density) placed at Healthcare Org onsite clinics.

name: imaging_total_results
label: Total Imaging Results
description: Distinct IMAGINGRESULT documents (CLINICALORDERTYPE matching Mammo / DEXA / Bone Density) received at Healthcare Org onsite clinics.

name: imaging_order_to_result_rate
label: Order → Result %
description: Ratio of distinct imaging results to distinct imaging orders in the selected window. NB: orders and results are matched by window not by parent linkage; use as a leading indicator of throughput.

name: imaging_sendout_results
label: Send-out Results
description: Distinct imaging results performed at an outside radiology center (sent out rather than done in-house). Leakage volume.

name: imaging_inhouse_results
label: In-house Results
description: Distinct imaging results performed at a Healthcare Org onsite facility.

name: imaging_sendout_rate
label: Send-out Rate %
description: Share of imaging results that were performed at an outside facility rather than in-house. Numerator: sendout_result_did. Denominator: result_did.

name: heartwise_eligible_patients
label: Heartwise Eligible (Clinical)
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id with at least one ICD10 hypertension (I1*) AND (diabetes (E1*) OR CKD (N18*)) on any clinical encounter, regardless of athena tag. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_enrolled_patients
label: Heartwise Enrolled (athena)
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id whose athena 'Heartwise for Her' custom demographic value = 'Heartwise patient' (actually enrolled in the program). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_candidate_patients
label: Heartwise Candidates (athena)
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id whose athena 'Heartwise for Her' custom demographic value = 'Heartwise candidate' (clinic-tagged for outreach, not yet enrolled). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_declined_patients
label: Heartwise Declined (athena)
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id whose athena 'Heartwise for Her' custom demographic value = 'Declined' (offered and refused). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_tagged_patients
label: Heartwise Tagged (Any)
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id with ANY athena 'Heartwise for Her' tag (Enrolled OR Candidate OR Declined). Total athena outreach universe.

name: heartwise_eligible_enrolled_patients
label: Eligible & Enrolled
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients (HTN + (DM/CKD)) who are actually enrolled ('Heartwise patient'). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_eligible_candidate_patients
label: Eligible & Candidate (Pipeline)
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients tagged as 'Heartwise candidate' - the live outreach pipeline. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_eligible_declined_patients
label: Eligible & Declined
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients who declined. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_eligible_untagged_patients
label: Eligible & Untagged (Intake Gap)
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients with NO athena 'Heartwise for Her' tag at all - clinic has not yet acted on this patient. Primary intake-gap capture opportunity. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_eligible_not_enrolled_patients
label: Eligible Not Enrolled
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients not enrolled - umbrella intervention target (candidates + declined + untagged combined). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_enrolled_not_eligible_patients
label: Enrolled Without Clinical Eligibility
description: Cohort: actually-enrolled patients without a recorded HTN+(DM/CKD) encounter diagnosis - data-quality / chart-review target. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: heartwise_enrollment_rate
label: Enrollment Rate (Eligible) %
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients. = eligible_enrolled / eligible x 100. Real enrollment, not candidates.

name: heartwise_candidate_rate
label: Candidate Rate (Eligible) %
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients. = eligible_candidate / eligible x 100. Share of eligibles in the live outreach pipeline.

name: heartwise_intake_gap_rate
label: Intake Gap Rate (Eligible) %
description: Cohort: clinically eligible patients. = eligible_untagged / eligible x 100. Share of eligibles the clinic has not yet acted on.

name: zio_patch_patients
label: Zio Patch Patients
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Count of distinct patient_id with at least one non-deleted athena document tied to a clinicalordertype name LIKE 'ZIO%'. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: zio_patch_orders
label: Zio Patch Orders
description: Cohort: active MDM patients. Sum of zio_order_count across the mart (one order = one non-deleted athena Zio-named document).

name: zio_and_heartwise_eligible_patients
label: Zio Patients Heartwise Eligible
description: Cohort: Zio Patch patients. Count of distinct patient_id who also meet Heartwise clinical eligibility (HTN + (DM/CKD)). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: zio_and_heartwise_enrolled_patients
label: Zio Patients Heartwise Enrolled
description: Cohort: Zio Patch patients who are actually enrolled in Heartwise ('Heartwise patient'). Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: zio_and_heartwise_candidate_patients
label: Zio Patients Heartwise Candidate
description: Cohort: Zio Patch patients tagged as 'Heartwise candidate'. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: zio_without_heartwise_patients
label: Zio Without Heartwise Tag
description: Cohort: Zio Patch patients with NO Heartwise athena tag at all - coordination gap / monitoring-only population. Snapshot at as_of_date.

name: established_active_patients
label: Established Active Patients
description: Active patients (computed patient_status) with at least one completed visit — panel denominator for No Next established dashboard.

name: with_next_visit_rate
label: % With Next Visit
description: Percentage of established active patients with at least one MDM-compliant future appointment scheduled.

name: awv_completion_rate_active
label: % AWV Completed (Active Panel)
description: Percentage of MDM Active patients (computed patient_status) with a completed AWV YTD. Numerator: completed AWV. Denominator: all MDM Active patients on attribution detail.

name: awv_gap_rate_active
label: % AWV Gap (Active Panel)
description: Percentage of MDM Active patients with no AWV completed or scheduled YTD among analytics-eligible patients. Numerator: AWV gap. Denominator: all MDM Active patients.

name: cadence_active_patients
label: Active Patients
description: Active panel (>=1 completed visit within 548 days): count of distinct active patients. Numerator: distinct active patient_id.

name: cadence_on_cadence_patients
label: On-Cadence Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients ON cadence — a qualifying baseline exists AND days since last QUALIFYING visit <= tier threshold (Highly Complex<=23 / High<=45 / Rising<=68 / Low<=182 for last qualifying visits on/after 2026-04-13 else <=274). MDM-compliant qualifying visits only (excludes ancillary/BH). Excludes No-Tier.

name: cadence_off_cadence_patients
label: Off-Cadence Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients OFF cadence — no qualifying baseline in the 730d lookback, OR days since last QUALIFYING visit > tier threshold (Highly Complex>23 / High>45 / Rising>68 / Low>182 for last qualifying visits on/after 2026-04-13 else >274). MDM-compliant qualifying visits only. Excludes No-Tier.

name: cadence_patients_with_future_appt
label: Patients with Future Appt (Any)
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with at least one future appointment of ANY type booked (Salesforce future appointment count > 0). Descriptive; cadence logic uses Next Qualifying Visit Booked.

name: cadence_scheduled_on_tier_patients
label: Next Qualifying Visit Booked
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with a SCHEDULED (non-cancelled) QUALIFYING visit booked after today (MDM-compliant; excludes ancillary/BH). The Goal B 'has a next visit' axis.

name: cadence_off_cadence_unscheduled_patients
label: Off-Cadence - No Next Visit
description: Active panel: distinct off-cadence active patients with NO next qualifying visit booked (Off Cadence - No Next Visit). Intervention target. Off-Cadence - Next Beyond = cadence_off_cadence_patients minus this measure.

name: cadence_proposed_on_cadence_patients
label: Proposed On-Cadence Patients
description: Active panel: distinct patients ON cadence under proposed-tier thresholds (falls back to current_tier when proposed_tier is NULL). Qualifying-visit baseline; same bands as legacy cadence (23/45/68/182|274).

name: cadence_proposed_off_cadence_patients
label: Proposed Off-Cadence Patients
description: Active panel: distinct patients OFF cadence under proposed-tier thresholds (falls back to current_tier when proposed_tier is NULL). Re-tier catch-up intervention pool.

name: cadence_proposed_on_cadence_rate
label: Proposed On-Cadence Rate %
description: Active panel: proposed-on-cadence patients / all active patients x 100. Program goal is 70% by 2027-02-17.

name: cadence_proposed_off_cadence_unscheduled_patients
label: Proposed Off-Cadence - No Next Visit
description: Active panel: proposed-off-cadence patients with no next qualifying visit booked. Primary scheduling intervention target under the re-tier program.

name: cadence_off_cadence_masked_by_nonqualifying_patients
label: Off-Cadence Masked by Non-Qualifying
description: Diagnostic: active patients who would appear ON cadence under the legacy any-visit logic (an ancillary/BH visit kept days_since_last_visit within threshold) but are OFF under the MDM-compliant qualifying-visit logic. Measures the cadence MDM-alignment delta.

name: cadence_meets_visit_target_patients
label: Meets Visit Target
description: Active panel: distinct active patients whose trailing-12mo QUALIFYING completed visits meet the tier visit/yr target (Low 2 / Rising 4 / High 6 / Highly Complex 12). MDM-compliant qualifying visits only.

name: cadence_on_cadence_rate
label: On-Cadence Rate %
description: Active panel: on-cadence active patients / all active patients x 100. On cadence = qualifying baseline exists AND days since last QUALIFYING visit <= tier threshold. MDM-compliant. Excludes No-Tier from numerator.

name: cadence_off_cadence_rate
label: Off-Cadence Rate %
description: Active panel: off-cadence active patients / all active patients x 100. Off cadence = no qualifying baseline OR days since last QUALIFYING visit > tier threshold. MDM-compliant.

name: cadence_visit_target_attainment_rate
label: Visit Target Attainment %
description: Active panel: active patients meeting their tier visit/yr target (QUALIFYING completed visits) / all active patients x 100.

name: cadence_proposed_tier_patients
label: Proposed-Tier Patients
description: Active panel with sufficient clinical signal AND >=12 months tenure (first completed visit >=12 months ago): distinct patients assigned a proposed tier under the Excel rubric (chronic-condition count bands + polypharmacy/HRM, high-utilization, and frailty escalators (no age add-on)). Group by proposed_tier for the proposed distribution; group by current_tier + proposed_tier for the migration matrix.

name: cadence_tier_upgrade_patients
label: Tier Upgrades
description: Active panel: distinct patients whose proposed clinical tier is HIGHER than their current Salesforce tier (under-tiered today).

name: cadence_tier_downgrade_patients
label: Tier Downgrades
description: Active panel: distinct patients whose proposed clinical tier is LOWER than their current Salesforce tier (over-tiered today).

name: cadence_tier_nochange_patients
label: Tier Unchanged
description: Active panel: distinct patients whose proposed clinical tier equals their current Salesforce tier.

name: cadence_tier_insufficient_patients
label: Insufficient Tier Data
description: Active panel: distinct active patients who cannot get a proposed tier: insufficient clinical signal (no chronic-condition, medication, utilization, or frailty data) OR <12 months tenure (first completed visit <12 months ago or unknown). Data-quality / new-patient gap.

name: cadence_low_risk_patients
label: Low Tier Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients whose proposed rubric tier is Low (proposed_rank=1). Excel-rubric: 0 chronic conditions and no risk-factor bundle.

name: cadence_rising_risk_patients
label: Rising Risk Tier Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients whose proposed rubric tier is Rising (proposed_rank=2). Excel-rubric: 0 chronic conditions + risk-factor bundle, or escalator-promoted.

name: cadence_polypharmacy_patients
label: Polypharmacy Escalator Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with the polypharmacy escalator (>5 active non-supplement medications). +1 tier escalator under the Excel rubric.

name: cadence_hrm_patients
label: High-Risk Medication Escalator Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with a high-risk medication (Beers) escalator (any single-agent HRM or two-same-class). +1 tier escalator under the Excel rubric.

name: cadence_high_util_patients
label: High Utilization Escalator Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with the high-utilization escalator (>4 ED/IP admits in 12mo). +1 tier escalator under the Excel rubric.

name: cadence_frailty_patients
label: Frailty Escalator Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with the frailty escalator (frailty ICD-10 proxy). +1 tier escalator under the Excel rubric.

name: cadence_risk_factor_patients
label: Risk-Factor Bundle Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients with any rubric risk factor (smoking, SDOH, osteopenia, pre-diabetes, cognitive impairment, urinary incontinence, hearing/vision impairment, out-of-range A1c/BP/PHQ-9/Mini-Cog). Descriptive bundle; splits Low tier only.

name: cadence_high_risk_patients
label: High Risk Tier Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients whose proposed rubric tier is High (proposed_rank=3). Excel-rubric: chronic-count bands + polypharmacy/HRM, high-utilization, and frailty escalators + age add-on.

name: cadence_highly_complex_patients
label: Highly Complex Tier Patients
description: Active panel: distinct active patients whose proposed rubric tier is Highly Complex (proposed_rank=4). Excel-rubric: chronic-count bands + polypharmacy/HRM, high-utilization, and frailty escalators + age add-on.

name: eov_qualifying_visits
label: EOV Qualifying Visits
description: DEV-4138 denominator: distinct completed qualifying patient visits in the period. Matches the provider-bonus NEXT_VISIT denominator so EOV rates reconcile 1:1 with MOR - Patient Engagement.

name: eov_next_visit_scheduled
label: Next Visit Scheduled at EOV
description: Distinct completed qualifying visits where a future qualifying patient visit was booked as of the visit date (MOR metric #9 numerator).

name: eov_next_visit_rate
label: Next Visit at EOV %
description: MOR metric #9: completed qualifying visits with a next visit booked at end-of-visit / all completed qualifying visits x 100. Same definition as the provider bonus NEXT_VISIT metric.

name: eov_medicare_visits
label: EOV Medicare Visits
description: DEV-4138 AWV denominator: distinct completed qualifying visits classified Medicare at visit time.

name: eov_next_awv_scheduled
label: Next AWV Scheduled at EOV
description: Distinct completed Medicare qualifying visits with a future AWV booked (within the 395-day window) as of the visit date (MOR metric #11 numerator).

name: eov_next_awv_rate
label: Next AWV at EOV %
description: MOR metric #11: Medicare completed qualifying visits with a future AWV booked at end-of-visit / all Medicare completed qualifying visits x 100. Same definition as the provider bonus AWV metric.

name: eov_on_cadence
label: Scheduled On Cadence
description: Distinct completed qualifying visits whose next qualifying visit was booked within the patient's tier cadence threshold (HC 23 / High 45 / Rising 68 / else 182|274 days). Strict subset of Next Visit Scheduled.

name: eov_on_cadence_rate
label: Scheduled On Cadence %
description: MOR metric #10: completed qualifying visits with the next visit booked within the tier cadence threshold / all completed qualifying visits x 100.

name: eov_avg_days_to_next_visit
label: Avg Days to Next Visit
description: Average days between the completed visit and the earliest future qualifying visit booked at end-of-visit (over visits that had a next visit scheduled).

name: appointments_avg_duration
label: Avg Appointment Duration (min)
description: DEV-4139: average scheduled appointment duration in minutes over appointments in the selected period. Cut by MA vs Provider via the ma_vs_provider dimension.

name: appointments_cancelled_lt_7d
label: Cancelled <7 Days
description: DEV-4139: distinct appointments cancelled within 7 days of the scheduled start (short-notice cancellations).

name: appointments_cancelled_lt_48h
label: Cancelled <48 Hours
description: DEV-4139: distinct appointments cancelled within 48 hours of the scheduled start (late cancellations).

name: appointments_cancelled_lt_7d_rate
label: Short-Notice Cancel (<7d) %
description: DEV-4139: of all cancelled appointments, the share cancelled within 7 days of the scheduled start x 100.

name: appointments_cancelled_lt_48h_rate
label: Late Cancel (<48h) %
description: DEV-4139: of all cancelled appointments, the share cancelled within 48 hours of the scheduled start x 100.

name: appointments_avg_days_to_cancel
label: Avg Days Scheduled to Cancel
description: DEV-4139: average whole days between when an appointment was scheduled and when it was cancelled (cancelled appointments only).

name: appointments_true_cancellation_rate
label: True Cancellation Rate %
description: DEV-4139: cancellation rate excluding reschedules -- truly cancelled (never rescheduled) appointments / total appointments x 100. Complements true_cancel_rate_resolved (which is over cancelled, not total).

name: population_active_patients
label: Active Patients (EOM)
description: CANONICAL Active Patients as of month-end (548-day rule; reconstructed point-in-time back to the start of Athena history). EOM stock — latest per period; never sum across months.

name: population_active_members
label: Active Members (EOM)
description: CANONICAL Active Members as of month-end — strict subset of Active Patients (Active enrollment + Membership member-since + canonically Active patient). EOM stock.

name: population_active_members_raw
label: Active Members Raw (EOM)
description: Membership-system-only active members at month-end (no patient gate). Diff vs population_active_members = SF/Membership reconciliation queue. EOM stock.

name: population_total_patients
label: Total Patients (EOM)
description: All patients with any reconstructed status as of month-end (Active + Inactive + Excluded + Deleted). EOM stock.

name: population_inactive_patients
label: Inactive Patients (EOM)
description: Patients canonically Inactive as of month-end. EOM stock.

name: population_active_member_share
label: Active Member Share %
description: Active Members as a percentage of Active Patients at month-end (subset rate; canonical hierarchy).

name: membership_unique_patients_seen
label: Unique Patients Seen (Members)
description: Distinct members who completed at least one visit in the month. Distinct WITHIN each month — cross-month totals overcount repeat patients; use with a monthly time axis.

name: medical_revenue
label: Medical Revenue
description: Total CMS-paid Medicare Advantage revenue (PAYOR_A total MA payment / PAYOR_B gross revenue) for the period. Additive across months and payors.

name: medical_cost
label: Medical Cost (Paid)
description: Total paid medical claim cost for the period (includes claim-only member-months so real cost is never dropped). Additive across months and payors.

name: medical_loss_ratio
label: Medical Loss Ratio % (Headline)
description: Headline medical loss ratio = GROSS paid medical cost / CMS-paid revenue, as a percent. Gross is the true MLR (the medical feed's pharmacy is Part B / plan liability; true Part D = $0). SUM(cost)/SUM(revenue) so it recomputes at any grouping.

name: member_months_paid
label: Member Months
description: Paid member-months in the period (the PMPM denominator). Additive across months and payors.

name: revenue_pmpm
label: Revenue PMPM
description: Revenue per paid member-month = SUM(revenue) / SUM(member_months). Recomputes correctly at any grouping.

name: cost_pmpm
label: Cost PMPM
description: Paid cost per paid member-month = SUM(cost) / SUM(member_months). Recomputes correctly at any grouping.

name: medical_cost_inpatient
label: Inpatient Cost
description: Paid inpatient facility cost for the period. Additive.

name: medical_cost_outpatient
label: Outpatient Cost
description: Paid outpatient facility cost for the period. Additive.

name: medical_cost_emergency
label: Emergency Cost
description: Paid emergency cost for the period. Additive.

name: medical_cost_professional
label: Professional Cost
description: Paid professional (office/clinic/telehealth) cost for the period. Additive.

name: medical_cost_pharmacy
label: Pharmacy Cost
description: Paid pharmacy cost captured on the medical feed for the period. Additive. (PAYOR_B Rx is a separate feed and is not included here.)

name: medical_cost_post_acute
label: Post-Acute Cost
description: Paid post-acute / skilled-nursing cost for the period. Additive.

name: medical_cost_other
label: Other Cost
description: Paid cost not mapped to a named service category for the period. Additive.

name: medical_expected_revenue
label: Expected Revenue (RAF)
description: RAF × county-benchmark expected revenue over resolved member-months. Additive.

name: medical_revenue_gap
label: Revenue Gap
description: Actual minus RAF-expected revenue over resolved member-months (positive = paid above expected). Additive.

name: medical_cost_part_d
label: Medical Cost (Part D - carved out)
description: TRUE Part D pharmacy paid (rx_part_d_indicator='Y') — the only cost netted out of the ex-Part-D view. ~$0 today (Part D sponsor pays). Additive.

name: medical_cost_plan_liability
label: Medical Cost (ex-Part D)
description: Paid medical cost net of TRUE Part D only (total_cost - cost_part_d). Equals gross cost today; the medical feed's pharmacy is Part B (plan liability). Additive.

name: medical_loss_ratio_plan_liability
label: Medical Loss Ratio % (ex-Part D)
description: Secondary ex-Part-D loss ratio = (cost - true Part D) / revenue, as a percent. Equals the headline GROSS MLR today (Part D = $0). SUM(cost)/SUM(revenue) so it recomputes at any grouping.

name: cost_pmpm_plan_liability
label: Cost PMPM (Plan Liability)
description: Plan-liability paid cost per paid member-month = SUM(plan-liability cost) / SUM(member_months). Recomputes correctly at any grouping.

name: paid_raf
label: Paid RAF (avg)
description: Member-month-weighted average paid (payment) RAF = SUM(paid RAF over paid member-months) / SUM(member_months). Recomputes correctly at any grouping.

name: provider_medical_revenue
label: Provider Revenue
description: CMS-paid MA revenue attributed to the provider's panel. Additive across months and providers.

name: provider_medical_cost
label: Provider Medical Cost (Gross)
description: Gross paid medical cost for the provider's panel. Additive.

name: provider_medical_cost_plan_liability
label: Provider Medical Cost (Plan Liability)
description: Paid medical cost net of Part D pharmacy for the provider's panel. Additive; correct basis for provider plan-liability MLR.

name: provider_mlr_plan_liability
label: Provider MLR % (Plan Liability)
description: Blended provider medical loss ratio = plan-liability cost / revenue, as a percent. Aggregated as SUM(cost)/SUM(revenue) so it recomputes correctly at any provider/period rollup.

name: provider_cost_pmpm_plan_liability
label: Provider Cost PMPM (Plan Liability)
description: Plan-liability paid cost per paid member-month for the provider = SUM(plan-liability cost) / SUM(member_months).

name: provider_paid_raf
label: Provider Paid RAF (avg)
description: Member-month-weighted average paid RAF for the provider's panel = SUM(paid RAF over paid member-months) / SUM(member_months).

name: provider_member_months
label: Provider Member Months
description: Paid member-months for the provider's panel. Additive (rate denominator).

name: provider_panel_members
label: Provider Panel Size (latest mo.)
description: Distinct attributed members with a paid member-month in the most recent month (semiadditive last). Provider panel size.

name: specialty_paid_cost
label: Paid Cost
description: Total paid medical cost for the payor × month × service-category × specialty slice. Additive across slices.

name: specialty_claim_lines
label: Claim Lines
description: Paid claim lines in the slice. Additive across slices.

name: pharmacy_paid_cost
label: Pharmacy Paid Cost
description: Total plan-paid pharmacy dollars (gross) for the slice. Additive across slices.

name: pharmacy_paid_cost_plan_liability
label: Pharmacy Cost (Plan Liability)
description: Plan-paid pharmacy that is the plan's liability (non-Part-D / Part B: vaccines, CGM & diabetic DME, nebulizer drugs). Additive.

name: pharmacy_paid_cost_part_d
label: Pharmacy Cost (Part D)
description: Plan-paid pharmacy adjudicated under Part D (expected ~$0 — the Part D sponsor pays). Additive.

name: pharmacy_claim_lines
label: Pharmacy Claim Lines
description: Paid pharmacy claim lines in the slice. Additive.

name: diagnosis_paid_cost
label: Paid Cost
description: PAYOR_B H2001 paid medical cost by primary diagnosis and company (Healthcare Org vs VendorBlue). Additive across slices.

name: diagnosis_claim_lines
label: Claims
description: Distinct paid claims by primary diagnosis and company on the PAYOR_B H2001 contract. Additive across slices.

name: financial_paid_raf
label: Financial Paid RAF (avg)
description: Member-month-weighted average FINANCIAL paid RAF = SUM(CMS-paid factor over paid member-months) / SUM(member_months). The CMS-paid factor (cms_paid_raf) is the risk score CMS actually paid on (revenue file), present for every paid member-month including VendorBlue, distinct from the claims/HCC-derived paid_raf. Recomputes correctly at any grouping.

name: medical_expected_revenue_financial
label: Expected Revenue (Financial RAF)
description: County-benchmark x CMS-paid factor (cms_paid_raf) expected revenue over resolved member-months. Company-splittable (populated for VendorBlue), unlike Expected Revenue (RAF) which uses the Healthcare-only payment score. Additive.

name: medical_revenue_gap_financial
label: Revenue Gap (Financial)
description: Actual minus financial (CMS-paid factor) expected revenue over resolved member-months (positive = paid above expected). Additive.

name: hcc_acceptance_rate
label: Acceptance %
description: Share of surfaced HCC codes ACCEPTED by the provider. Denominator = the VendorNav sent roster.

name: hcc_accepted
label: Accepted
description: Count of HCC codes ACCEPTED by the assessing provider (final disposition = ACCEPTED).

name: hcc_assessed
label: Assessed
description: Count of surfaced HCC codes that were assessed (any disposition: accepted, held, or rejected).

name: hcc_assessment_rate
label: Assessment %
description: Share of surfaced (sent-roster) HCC codes that were assessed. Denominator = codes VendorNav showed the provider, NOT all HCCs.

name: hcc_claim_closed
label: Claim Closed (2026)
description: Count of HCC codes closed via an adjudicated 2026 claim — the PAID-closure verifier (lags the CODED capture).

name: hcc_claim_rate
label: Claim-Closed %
description: Share of surfaced HCC codes closed via a paid 2026 claim.

name: hcc_distinct_codes
label: Distinct HCC Codes
description: Distinct HCC codes on the sent roster.

name: hcc_held
label: Held
description: Count of HCC codes HELD (deferred) by the assessing provider.

name: hcc_missing_future_appt_rate
label: % With Future Appt
description: Share of missing patients who already have an upcoming appointment.

name: hcc_missing_recapture
label: Missing Recapture
description: Prior-year-coded HCCs (2025), not re-closed 2026, VendorNav-silent, off-roster.

name: hcc_missing_suspect
label: Missing Suspect
description: HH-inferred suspects VendorNav has no flag for, off-roster.

name: hcc_missing_total
label: Missing Patients
description: HH recapture/suspect VendorNav is silent on AND not on the sent roster.

name: hcc_not_assessed
label: Not Assessed
description: Count of surfaced HCC codes NOT ADDRESSED (shown to the provider but no disposition recorded).

name: hcc_patient_count
label: Patients
description: Distinct patients on the sent roster (patients VendorNav surfaced HCCs for).

name: hcc_pcp_differ_rate
label: Assessing<>PCP %
description: Share of comparable 2026-captured HCCs assessed by a non-PCP provider (pcp_differs / pcp_compared).

name: hcc_pcp_differs
label: Assessing <> PCP
description: Count of 2026-captured HCCs where the assessing provider differed from the patient's PCP.

name: hcc_pcp_match
label: Assessing = PCP
description: Count of 2026-captured HCCs where the assessing provider was the patient's PCP.

name: hcc_recapture
label: HH Recapture (closed 2025)
description: OPPORTUNITY count — HCCs closed in the prior year (2025), i.e. recapture candidates/targets. Standalone count; NEVER a rate denominator. Spans surfaced + VendorNav-silent.

name: hcc_recapture_needs_sched
label: Recapture — Needs Scheduling
description: Missing recaptures with no 2026 visit — the priority worklist.

name: hcc_recapture_no_future_rate
label: Recapture · No Future Visit
description: Share of missing RECAPTURE patients with no future 2026 visit scheduled — need a visit booked.

name: hcc_recapture_rate
label: HH Recapture %
description: Recapture candidates as a share of the roster.

name: hcc_rejected
label: Rejected
description: Count of HCC codes REJECTED by the assessing provider.

name: hcc_suspect
label: HH Suspect (net-new 2026)
description: OPPORTUNITY count — non-recapture HCCs with 2026 activity (suspect candidates; closure-truth = on the 2026 record, not closed either year). Standalone count; NEVER a rate denominator.

name: hcc_suspect_no_future_rate
label: Suspect · No Future Visit
description: Share of missing SUSPECT patients with no future 2026 visit scheduled — need a visit booked.

name: hcc_total_hccs
label: Total HCCs
description: Total HCC codes on the sent roster.

name: navina_sent_roster
label: Sent Roster
description: Patients on the gold roster we send to VendorNav (sum of is_sent over mart_navina_roster).

name: navina_total_patients
label: Total VendorNav Patients
description: Patients VendorNav returned data on (sum of is_returned over mart_navina_roster).

name: navina_patients_with_hcc
label: VendorNav Patients with HCC
description: Patients with >= 1 actionable HCC suggestion (sum of has_hcc over mart_navina_roster).

name: attrition_patients
label: Attrition Patients
description: Patients whose computed patient_status is Inactive and who have a became_inactive_date (previously active then lapsed). Counted on the date they became inactive; bind a date range on became_inactive_date to window the count.
